items.title: Berkshire Hathaway latest: Q3 earnings, top 5 holdings, record stock buyback, & more
items.summary:
Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B, BRK-A) reported third quarter earnings results and bought a record $9.6 billion of its own shares.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley take a closer look at the results.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway earnings expose unexpected problem beneath strong economy
items.summary: One set of numbers tells two stories.

items.title: The Institutional Flight-to-Quality Rotation Is On So I Buy Alphabet
items.summary: Alphabet has slid nearly 19% in a month while institutions quietly shift toward quality. One investor keeps buying each dip, yet a negative cash flow figure and heavy share-sale capacity could still turn this bet sour.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Boosts Buybacks as Operating Income Slips
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. spent about $9.6 billion to buy back its own shares in the third quarter, a sign the company's executives viewed the stock as undervalued. But declining insurance underwriting weighed on its operating earnings in a mixed quarter for the company. Bloomberg's Matthew Palazola joins to discuss.

items.title: Barrick Mining Moves on Earnings; Google's New AI Chips | Stock Movers
items.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Shares of Barrick Mining (B) rose in premarket trading after the miner reported third-quarter earnings that beat the average analyst estimate as strength in gold offset copper weakness. The company also said that its Nevada Gold Mines initial public offering remains on track for late 2026 or early 2027.
- Shares of Alphabet (GOOG) edged higher after news Google is rolling out a broader array of AI chips, aiming to capitalize on its rapid ascent as a challenger to Nvidia. The company is introducing two new variations of its tensor processing units, or TPUs, custom-made semiconductors that help run AI software. 
- Shares of KKR & Co. (KKR) rallied in the early session after the company reported a third-quarter profit that beat analysts' estimates as the "mini Berkshire" unit that holds long-term private equity bets mitigated a slump at its Global Atlantic insurance arm.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway's Top AI Holding Is Poised to Outperform
items.summary: The conglomerate's fourth-largest position is in an internet business whose share price has fallen 28% from the peak.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway and 16 Other Big Funds Bought Alphabet. It’s Down 22% Since. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBerkshire Hathaway (BRK. B) grew its Alphabet (GOOGL:NASDAQ) stake 45% in the Q2, and at least 16 other big funds bought or added shares, according to their 13Fs for the quarter ended June 30.
